# The Ident

> The Ident is a UK casting app and website where actors, dancers, singers and other performers find castings, auditions and paid work, apply with their reel and CV, and track every self-tape, recall and booking — and where casting directors post roles, review applicants and search for talent.

- Website: https://www.theident.me — the app runs in the browser at https://app.theident.me
- Who it's for: performers (actors, dancers, singers, musical theatre, voice artists, presenters — beginners, recent graduates and professionals) and casting directors, producers and companies.
- Open to everyone: no agent or drama school training is needed to join.
- What's different: pay and closing dates shown up front on roles; every casting tracked (applied, self-tape, recall, pencilled, booked); CV upload fills in your profile (including CVs from Spotlight or Mandy); no commission on work you book; Verified professional and Verified graduate badges; inclusive profile fields with private disability and access details.
- Pricing: browsing roles is free. Subscriptions have a 7-day free trial — Performer £3.99/month, Graduate £1.99/month (graduated in the last 2 years, verified), Casting £10.99/month. Cancel any time.
- How to register: go to https://www.theident.me, choose Performer or Casting, create an account with email, Apple or Google, and answer a few questions or upload a CV.
